headline: President Bush's 2002 order set up a presidential advisory board focused on Historically Black Colleges and Universities.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order created a President's Board of Advisors on Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs). Such a board gives the President advice about these schools. No summary was provided, so details about the board's members, duties, or any related programs are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The schools became the focus of a presidential advisory board that offers advice about them.
They may be affected by any advice the board gives, though the title alone does not show specific effects.
